# Refund handling

How support carries out a refund once the [refund policy](../policies/refund-policy.md) says it is due. Terms: [terms](../glossary/terms.md).

## Steps
1. Confirm the plan and the purchase or renewal date. 2. Check the window in the policy. 3. Record the reason on the account. 4. Request approval if needed. 5. Ask Finance to issue the refund. 6. Tell the customer when to expect it.

## Approval
Support may approve refunds up to 100 USD. Above that, or for any annual plan, Finance approves. Discount-related questions go to Sales Operations ([discounts](../policies/discounts.md)).

## Records
Every refund is recorded with its reason and approver. Refunds appear on invoices as described in [invoicing](invoicing.md).
